content:
Event type
Description
ImageMalwareDetectionEvent
Indicates that an image was detected to have malware; includes hash details
ImageMisconfigurationDetectionEvent
Indicates that an image was detected to have security misconfigurations
ImageSecretDetectionEvent
Indicates that secrets were detected on an image
ImageCISBenchmarkDetectionEvent
Indicates that a Center for Internet Security Benchmark issue for container images has been detected
